instruction.name: xvfrintrm.d
instruction.description: Round double-precision floating point elements in `a` to integers, rounding towards negative infinity, and store as floating point numbers.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvfrintrm.d $xr0, $xr8; xvfrintrm.d $xr1, $xr9; xvfrintrm.d $xr2, $xr10; xvfrintrm.d $xr3, $xr11; xvfrintrm.d $xr4, $xr12; xvfrintrm.d $xr5, $xr13; xvfrintrm.d $xr6, $xr14; xvfrintrm.d $xr7, $xr15
